summary: Suzi discusses the anniversary event rewards and shares her summoning strategy for the Option Summons banner. She focuses on building a high-end Dauntless team, selecting Dauntless and Toxin schools to target Guinavivre and copies of Serpentemis. She emphasizes that Dauntless teams require very high inspirations (such as Inspiration 5 Guinavivre) to survive and deal proper damage compared to more accessible teams like Ice Blast or Toxin. Finally, she highlights purchasing Guinavivre from the Temporal Corridor shop as a top priority for players looking to empower Dauntless.

teams.note: High-investment Dauntless team that demands high inspirations to survive and outperform easier alternatives like Ice Blast or Toxin.

tips: Dauntless teams require high inspirations (ideally Inspiration 5 on carries like Guinavivre) and heavy stat investment; without them, they struggle to survive and are outclassed by beginner-friendly teams like Ice Blast or Toxin.
Pairing overlapping schools in Option Summons (such as Thunderbolt and Dauntless to isolate Lightning) reduces the total hero pool and increases odds of pulling desired units.
Prioritize buying Guinavivre from the Temporal Corridor exchange using Dust-sealed Tomes if she is not already at Inspiration 5.
